title: Constant-factor hardness of Min-UnCut
exact_target: For every fixed integer $K\geq 2$, can 3SAT be reduced deterministically in polynomial time to an explicit finite simple unweighted graph and positive integer threshold k so that satisfiable inputs have minimum uncut-edge count $\leq k$ and unsatisfiable inputs have count $>Kk$?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
